enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the air conditioner running to stay cool during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain asleep. Shift position. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off alarm. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick clothes. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating a quick breakfast, and packing a water bottle for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out butter. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take plate. Take knife. Spread butter on toast. Eat toast. Drink water. Fill water bottle. Cap water bottle. Put water bottle in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Final check of work bag, putting on sunscreen, and gathering items before leaving for the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open work bag. Check contents. Zip bag. Pick up sunscreen. Open cap. Apply sunscreen to face. Apply to arms. Apply to neck. Close cap. Put sunscreen in bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in bag. Pick up bag. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital by public transport while avoiding direct sun and heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients and completing clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to physiotherapy department. Check patient list on computer. Call patient name. Escort patient to treatment room. Assess patient's mobility. Perform joint mobilization. Instruct patient on home exercises. Write clinical notes. Call next patient. Review patient's medical history. Discuss case with doctor. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch in cafeteria. Return to department. Treat afternoon patients. Update patient records. Clean treatment room.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital by public transport during the ongoing heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner with the induction cooker and eating it while hydrating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to relieve the heat and washing off the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the air-conditioned living room and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out drink. Close fridge. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing physiotherapy case notes and reading professional material on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on light. Turn on computer. Open case notes file. Read notes. Take notes. Open browser. Search for article. Read article. Highlight text. Close browser. Open case notes again. Review notes. Turn off computer. Turn off light. Walk out of study.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a streaming show and doing light stretching exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select show. Play show. Sit on floor. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Do yoga pose. Watch show. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Continue watching show.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, setting the alarm, and going to sleep with the air conditioner on for the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Plug in phone. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Fall asleep.
